name: The San-in Godo Bank,Ltd.
summary: The San-in Godo Bank,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of various banking products and services for individuals and corporate customers in Japan. The company operates through two segments: Banking and Leasing. It offers deposits, such as demand deposits, ordinary, installment savings accounts, time deposits, and negotiable certificates of deposit; and loans comprising corporate, syndicated, personal, educational, consumer, and housing loans, as well as credit card services.
